groups.split_policy: All members must receive the same train/validation/test assignment. Do not count the repeat or overhead cut as an independent shot.
groups.scope_note: Entire cached clips grouped conservatively, including pre-shot, overhead and wide views. Direct matching was measured only on the stated frame pairs; whole-clip framewise identity is not asserted.

limitations: The approximate source-time value in the ID is a label, not a verified absolute timestamp.
Grouping is metadata for future dataset builders; no training dataset or gameplay policy has been produced.
This grouping does not establish playback speed, original frame cadence or independent metric calibration.
